allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Kilitch Drugs (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Postponement in Finalization of Basis of Allotment and Allotment Schedule for Rights Issue '.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Kilitch Drugs (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding submission of Letter of Offer in connection with Proposed Rights Issue of the Fully Paid up Equity Shares in terms of Regulation 71(2) of SEBI(Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation 2018

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Kilitch Drugs (India) Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on July 12, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 2 : 23, i.e 2 Equity Shares for every 23 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 357 per share.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Kilitch Drugs (India) Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on July 09, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 2 : 23, i.e 2 Equity Shares for every 23 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 357 per share.
